title: Book of Revelation: people who cannot die
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Book of Revelation: people who cannot die, about end times at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: befalling on earth you have a group of people who cannot die

plain: Tim Alberino, who says he took part in the capture of a giant in Afghanistan, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about the Book of Revelation, the last book of the Christian Bible. He says that, in its account of the end times, as disaster falls on Earth there is a group of people who cannot die. He raises it as something that might connect to the beings he describes.
